title: Enterprise Long-Context & Multi-Turn Agent Context Compression & Prefix-Cache Preservation Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Unbounded Full-History & Raw Tool JSON Append
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 52K-token bloat by Turn 20, 2.45s TTFT & $240K/mo re-billing raw tool JSONs

tiers.name: Tier 2: Per-Turn Sliding-Window FIFO Drop (Shifts Token Offsets Every Turn!)
tiers.verdict: Trap: Dropping Turn 1 shifts all subsequent tokens, destroying 88% of KV prefix cache hits!

tiers.name: Tier 3: Re-Summarizing History on Every Turn with an LLM
tiers.verdict: Rewriting the summary on every turn invalidates prefix cache & adds +1.4s summary lag

tiers.name: Tier 4: K=8 Epoch Block Compaction + Tool-Output JQ Slimming + Pinned Goal Ledger
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 89.5% KV cache hit rate, 98.4% constraint memory, 340ms TTFT & -89.0% TCO
